043package dev.visdb.seesaw;
044
045import java.awt.event.FocusAdapter;
046import java.awt.event.FocusEvent;
047import java.lang.System.Logger;
048import java.util.EventListener;
049
050import javax.swing.JTextField;
051
052import dev.visdb.seesaw.navigate.RowsModel;
053import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff;
054import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsComponent;
055import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsTextSupport;
056import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsTextSupport.SsDocumentListener;
057import dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.SsUtils;
058
059import static dev.visdb.seesaw.utils.JStuff.sf;
060import static java.lang.System.Logger.Level.*;
061
062/**
063 * SsTextField extends the JTextField.
064 */
065@SuppressWarnings("serial")
066public class SsTextField extends JTextField implements SsComponent {
067  // TODO Consider adding an InputVerifier to prevent component from
068  // losing focus; see FormattedTextField.
069
070  /** Logger for component */
071  private static final Logger logger = JStuff.getLogger();
072
073  /**
074   * Constructs a new, empty text field.
075   */
076  public SsTextField() {
077    this(null);
078  }
079
080  /**
081   * Constructs a new text field with the given text.
082   * @param text initial text
083   */
084  public SsTextField(String text) {
085    this(text, null, null);
086  }
087
088  /**
089   * Creates a TextField instance and binds it to the specified RowSet column.
090   *
091   * @param rowsModel        model for a RowSet
092   * @param columnName name of the column to which this label should be bound
093   */
094  public SsTextField(RowsModel rowsModel, String columnName) {
095    this(null, rowsModel, columnName);
096  }
097
098  /** All the constructors feed through here */
099  private SsTextField(String text, RowsModel rowsModel, String columnName) {
100    super(text);
101    finishSsCommon();
102    if (rowsModel != null)
103      rowsModel.bind(this, columnName);
104  }
105
106  // /**
107  //  * Part of the scheme to keep text field in sync with data base.
108  //  */
109  // @Override
110  // protected Document createDefaultModel() {
111  //    Document doc = super.createDefaultModel();
112  //    return doc;
113  //    // return new SSPlainDocument(this);
114  // }
115
116  /**
117   * Add focus listener that selects all text.
118   * Add key listener for when this is used with mask. Use Mask Formatters.
119   */
120  @Override
121  public void customInit() {
122    // ADD FOCUS LISTENER TO THE TEXT FIELD SO THAT WHEN THE FOCUS IS GAINED
123    // COMPLETE TEXT SHOULD BE SELECTED
124    addFocusListener(new FocusAdapter() {
125      @Override
126      public void focusGained(FocusEvent fe) {
127        // TODO: Turn off any TextDecorator while focused
128        SsTextField.this.selectAll();
129      }
130    });
131  }
132
133  /** {@inheritDoc } */
134  @Override
135  public void cleanField() {
136    setText("");
137  }
138
139  private Hook hook;
140
141  /** {@inheritDoc } */
142  @Override
143  public final Hook getSsComponentHook() {
144    if (hook == null)
145      hook = new Hook(this) {
146        /**
147         * Updates the value stored and displayed in the SwingSet
148         * component based on getColumnText()
149         */
150        @Override
151        protected void updateSsComponent() {
152          final String text = getColumnText();
153          logger.log(DEBUG, () -> sf("%s: Setting text field to %s.", getColumnForLog(), text));
154          setText(text);
155        }
156
157        /** {@inheritDoc } */
158        @Override
159        protected SsDocumentListener getSsComponentListener() {
160          return SsTextSupport.getSsDocumentListener(SsTextField.this);
161        }
162
163        /** {@inheritDoc } */
164        @Override
165        protected void addSsComponentListener(EventListener eventListener) {
166          getDocument().addDocumentListener((SsDocumentListener) eventListener);
167        }
168
169        /** {@inheritDoc } */
170        @Override
171        protected void removeSsComponentListener(EventListener eventListener) {
172          getDocument().removeDocumentListener((SsDocumentListener) eventListener);
173        }
174      };
175    return hook;
176  }
177
178  /** {@inheritDoc} */
179  @Override
180  public String toString() {
181    return sf("%s{text=%s, %s}", getClass().getSimpleName(), getText(),
182              SsUtils.ssComponentToString(this));
183  }
184
185} // end public class SsTextField extends JTextField {
